'''2010 US East Nationals Sean Revell DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Sean Revell]] at [[2010 US East Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' ROPS
* '''Username:''' Dr. Rell
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
